topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I couldn’t believe it when I found out. All those hints and jokes about surprises were leading up to something, and now it’s just... not happening. I had this picture in my head of everyone jumping out from behind the couch, the balloons, the cake. I even picked out a special outfit. It’s just another quiet night instead. Maybe I wouldn’t have minded so much if I hadn’t been looking forward to it for so long. I guess plans change, and people get busy. It’s fine, I’ll figure out something to do on my own.
